deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is a draft of Riemann's work on the vanishing of theta functions of a genus-p Riemann surface (published form: 'Ueber das Verschwinden der Theta-Functionen', Crelle 65, 1866). The previous page shows, for the m=1 case, that a ratio of theta products equals a ratio of sums of first derivatives of theta times the abelian differentials phi_nu, and concludes that if all first derivatives of theta vanish at v=r then theta(alpha'-alpha+r) vanishes identically; by induction (letting z_m=zeta_m etc.) theta(sum_1^m alpha - sum_1^m alpha' + r) vanishing identically forces all derivatives of order < m of theta to vanish at r. The present page (folio 110v, numbered '4') starts the converse and the general-m identity.

(1) Notation. Riemann abbreviates theta(v_1,...,v_p) as theta((v)), writing only a generic argument and dropping indices (double brackets).

(2) Hypothesis (his): theta((sum_1^m u - sum_1^m alpha + r)) vanishes identically in the u, alpha, but theta((sum_1^{m+1} ...)) does not; the earlier assumption on the t's (t are constants chosen so that the first derivatives of theta at t do not all vanish; this is my reading of 'die frühere Voraussetzung', partly unclear).

(3) The expression. With points u^1..u^m (variable) and alpha^1..alpha^m (fixed), and arguments v, t (constants), he forms
E = theta((sum u - sum alpha + v)) * theta((sum alpha - sum u + v)) * prod_{nu != nu'} theta((u^nu - u^nu' + t)) * prod_{nu != nu'} theta((alpha^nu - alpha^nu' + t)) / [ prod_{mu,nu'} theta((u^mu - alpha^nu' + t)) * prod_{nu,mu'} theta((alpha^nu - u^mu' + t)) ],
products over 1..m, numerator excluding nu=nu'. (Here sum u means the vector sum of abelian integrals from fixed origin to the points; the 'z_k' are the upper limits.)

(4) Argument that E is algebraic in z_1: (a) across the period cuts each theta factor picks up exponential multipliers; these cancel between numerator and denominator, so E has multiplier 1 and is single-valued on the surface, hence (with controlled singularities) algebraic. (b) At z_1 = gamma_nu (and the companion points, the transcription 'epsilon_nu' is unclear) numerator and denominator both have infinities of second order, so E stays finite. (Reading: the gamma, epsilon seem to be the endpoints of the second set of points; unclear.) (c) The remaining zeros of numerator and denominator in z_1 are determined by z_2..z_m, v, t alone and so do not depend on the gamma's. Hence E = (algebraic function of z_1 independent of gamma) x (constant in z_1). Repeating in z_2, ..., z_m: E = chi(z_1..z_m) * (factor independent of z). By the symmetry z <-> gamma, that factor is chi(gamma_1..gamma_m) times a constant A independent of both. So E = A chi(z) chi(gamma). The next page (letter fragment begins there) sets Psi = sqrt(A) chi and gets E = Psi(z) Psi(zeta), then evaluates Psi by letting zeta collapse onto the points z (0/0 form, giving m-th derivatives of theta at r contracted with du's).

(5) Purpose: obtain a closed formula showing that if theta and derivatives up to order n-1... vanish at r and the n-th order derivatives do not all vanish, the identity holds for m <= n but fails at m = n+1; this yields the order-of-vanishing statement of the vanishing theorem (theta(sum_1^m alpha - sum alpha' + r) vanishes identically iff all derivatives of order < m vanish at r).

Marked as mine: the interpretation of sums as vector Abel sums, the multiplier-cancellation, and the symbol reading of gamma/epsilon. The page is heavily corrected pencil, many words illegible.
errors: Possible slip or transcription issue: the text says 'Nenner und Zähler werden unendlich von der zweiten Ordnung' at z_1 = gamma_nu, epsilon_nu; which points are meant is unclear from the scan, so the claim of finiteness cannot be fully checked.
No definite computational error found; the count of z_1-dependent theta factors balances (2m in numerator, 2m in denominator), consistent with the claim that the multiplier is 1 on the cuts.
Step 'E is algebraic' relies on E having no essential singularities and being single-valued on the cut surface; this is asserted, not detailed, but is standard.
The constant A is asserted independent of z and gamma by the symmetry argument; the logic needs that E is symmetric under exchange, which holds visibly from the form of E up to the choice of v sign.

results.what: Product of theta functions with u,alpha arguments is, in each variable, an algebraic function times a constant, so factorises as Psi(z)Psi(gamma) (cross-ratio-type / Prym-Fay-style factorisation)
results.modern_name: Factorisation of the theta quotient into prime-form-type function of two point sets; precursor of Fay's trisecant/ addition identities and of the vanishing theorem proof
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (1865-66 vanishing theorem); Fay 1973 for trisecant type identities

results.what: Theta(sum_1^m alpha - sum alpha' + r) vanishes identically iff all derivatives of theta of order < m vanish at r, and equation of E form holds for m up to the order of vanishing
results.modern_name: Riemann vanishing theorem / Riemann singularity theorem (multiplicity of theta at a point equals dimension of the linear system, Riemann-Kempf)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann 1865; Kempf 1973 for the multiplicity statement

Nothing here attributes a later result to him.
